verdict.rationale: v0 docs mention that a Project 'shares deployment, hosting, domains, and environment variables' for connected chats, implying custom domain support exists, but there is no explicit walkthrough or first-party documentation describing how a founder actually connects/configures a custom domain for a published app. Missing for 10: a dedicated domain-setup guide, DNS configuration steps, and independent/community confirmation that custom domains work end-to-end.
